balls.text: what a shot that is, but he's hit it straight to the fielder. Unadkat stays leg side of the ball, and slices it from a middle-stump line. It goes screaming off his bat, and it would have been four had it gone five yards in either direction. He's hit it straight to point, however, and Delhi are all out with 11 balls left to play.
he's holed out here. Tahir skips down the track, but doesn't get to the pitch, and he checks his shot a bit. It goes high in the air and drops into Rishi's hands at long-on
Patel bowls this wide of off stump, and Tahir throws his hands at it and cuts off the front foot
straighter this time, and it's defended back to the bowler off the back foot
pushed through, outside off, and Tahir defends off the back foot

He's gone! that's a straight ball, back of a length. Shami goes back and tries to work it with an extravagant twirl of his wrists but gets no bat on it as it sneaks through and hits top of middle-and-off
gives himself room to drive it wide of long-off
that's a rubbish delivery, but it's got him a wicket. It's short and wide, but Neesham isn't really in a good position to cut, and hits it uppishly, straight to backward point
quicker ball, full and on the stumps, and it's defended into the leg side
bit of turn into the left-hander this time, and he tucks it off his pads, past midwicket, and the bowler has to run all the way to field that
flatter, quicker, and Neesham is beaten trying to cut
that's short and wide, but Neesham can only bunt it towards point
bit of flight, but it drops down before Shahbaz can skip down the track and get to the pitch. Tucked off the pads towards midwicket
length ball, Neesham goes deep in his crease and punches it towards cover
worked off the pads behind square leg
gives himself room, looking for the cut, but it turns in, and he's forced to work it towards midwicket instead
on the stumps, and Neesham's worked it away towards midwicket
length ball, punched towards mid-off
shortish ball, and Neesham finds point with that cut
fuller now, on the stumps, and Nadeem's feet are frozen. But he manages to get decent contact and swat it away towards cover
whoa. That's nasty. It's short, and Nadeem takes his eye off it but just manages to duck his head under it
short, rising ball again, and Neesham plays it well, close to his body, bunting it down onto the pitch
short ball, and Neesham drops his gloves under the ball as it rises past him
straighter this time, and Neesham times this flick really well. Midwicket gives chase, and he seems to be in with a chance of cutting it off, but the ball simply doesn't slow down
tries to work this into the leg side from outside off, gets an inside edge onto the front pad
bit of bounce again, around chest-height this time, and Nadeem takes his bottom hand off the handle as he defends
poor work behind the stumps from Saha. It's a slower ball, and it angles down the leg side and goes to the keeper on the bounce, and it went between his legs
That's banged in, and it rises up towards Shahbaz's throat. Jumps up to keep it down.
Given! KP walks across his stumps again, and is hit on the front pad trying to work the ball around it. It was headed towards leg stump, or it was just missing. Can't really say with any certainty
back of a length, and a bit more width. Neesham is on the front foot, and he slaps it to the off-side sweeper from around waist-height
shorter now, and Neesham is beaten, trying to slice it past point
it's on that uncomfortable full-but-not-driveable length again, and angled towards off stump. Neesham pushes it back to the bowler
onto the pads now, and he tucks it to square leg
length ball, defended back to the bowler
shortish, spins back towards the stumps, and Neesham hurriedly changes his mind. He wanted to cut, but he pushes it softly into the off side instead.
got him! Tries to sweep again from outside off, but the ball drops shorter than he must have expected and bounced to take his top edge and loop towards cover
drifts away from Duminy, away from off stump, but it's a full-toss, and he sweeps hard to the left of a diving deep midwicket
back of a length, on the stumps, and KP goes back to work it towards midwicket
length ball, outside off, and Duminy is beaten as he throws his bat at it, attempting the flat-batted drive
slower ball, outside off stump, and KP presses forward, waits, and chops down on it to send it rolling towards third man
angled towards off stump, just back of a length, and Duminy tucks it to midwicket
that's a length ball, worked off the stumps to backward square leg
slower ball this time, angled away from Duminy, and he leans forward to push it to mid-off
angled across Duminy, who tries to drive through the off side, on the up, but only gets an inside-edge into the leg side
Akshar sees KP jumping down the track and shortens his length. KP defends it back to him.
forward press, defends this length ball into the leg side
what happened here? KP comes forward to defend. His bat comes down in that curtain-rail manner of his, and the inside edge sneaks past leg stump. Lucky boy, KP
that's a touch short, but it gives KP enough time to rock back and slap it to the right of backward point
KP goes forward and across, and laps this length ball from the stumps, very fine
full, onto the pads, and Duminy flicks it towards midwicket
angled towards middle stump. Duminy walks across and works that square on the leg side
length ball, angled in, wristed down to long-on
slower ball, angled in towards middle stump, defended down the pitch

what are you doing, Delhi? Has Tiwary sacrificed his wicket, or has KP just run past him? Tiwary bunted that straight to point, and KP just took off. Bailey is the fielder, and he only has to lob it underarm to the bowler to complete the simplest of run-outs.
shortish, wide of off, but not that short, and it sneaks under Tiwary's bat as he tries to chop it past point
tries to find the blockhole, I think, but gets his wrist position wrong and it slides down the leg side
tries to sweep this from outside off, but doesn't really time it. Easy stop for square leg
KP gives himself room and tries to drive wristily through cover, but he's too early into his shot, and the ball trickles into the leg side off his inside edge
Bailey gets a hand to this drive at cover, diving left, after Tiwary leans forward and drives
that's another shortish ball, and it's cut to deep point. They run two, and Tiwary just beats the throw to the keeper with the dive.
that's short, but KP finds cover with his cut. Misfield allows him to take the single
that is a lot of loop, and Tiwary waits and waits before driving to the sweeper
nice shot, but only one. KP gives himself room and drives this inside-out to wide long-on
angled in towards off stump. KP is out of his crease to wrist this down the ground to long-on
slower ball, drifts onto the pads, and it's clipped to the right of deep midwicket
this one shapes away a little, with a bit of extra bounce, and Tiwary is beaten as he tries to dab it towards third man
loses his line completely. It's way wide of off stump, and KP reaches out to slap it to deep point
unlucky! that swung back in, very late, and KP inside edges that attempted cover drive past his stumps
onto the pads, and it's flicked to deep midwicket

what a shot that is, and what a stop. KP gets a lot of bottom hand into this sweep from way outside off, and Glenn Maxwell throws himself to his right after running around from deep midwicket to save two runs
length ball, outside off, and Tiwary stretches forward to sweep it to deep backward square leg
Tiwary goes back now, and it's flatter. Chopped away to point.
bit of flight on this, and KP opts to go deep in his crease and look for the cut. It's too close to off stump, and he can only hit it straight to point
back of a length, on the pads, and it's worked away towards square leg
full, outside off, and wide mid-off dives left to cut off the drive

gone! Jadhav danced down the pitch and seemed to time that flat-batted drive really well. But he doesn't keep it down, and he doesn't get any real elevation either, and Vohra takes it just above his head at mid-off
bit of inward movement again as Jadhav pushes out at it. Drops it down safely into the off side, off the inside half of his bat
tries to slash this length ball through cover, I think, but it comes in a touch and beats his inside edge
shuffles out of his crease, Awana shortens his length a touch, and KJ knocks it back to the bowler with a flick of his wrist
got him! did that straighten a bit? Maybe. DK was back in his crease, and he tried to flick it from off stump towards midwicket, but he ends up getting a leading edge that loops into point's hands.

Awana appeals as KP is struck on the pads after moving across to flick to the on-side. The ball might have hit him outside the line. They sneak a leg-bye, as the cover fielder misses the stumps at the non-striker's end
slashes at this one, just back of a length, and slices it to third man
lovely shot. That was a length ball, and there wasn't too much width on it, and KP stays next to the line of the ball and swings freely through the line to the left of extra cover
full, almost in the blockhole, and just outside off. DK gets back and across and pushes it with a straight bat towards mid-off
KP looks to flick this over the leg side, but he gets a leading edge, possibly because of the angle, and it loops over cover. Dhawan slides and cuts it off just short of the rope.
that's a touch short. KP slashes hard, but Rishi Dhawan makes a good stop at cover point, tumbling to his right
that's full and wide, and KP has a lot of time to drive it between a deepish cover point and a shortish extra cover
oh, lovely shot. Awana has given him width, but it wasn't a half-volley. DK leans over it and times this drive sweetly to the left of a diving cover fielder
length ball, on off and middle, and KP hurries to the other end after pushing it wristily to mid-on
that's definitely a slower ball, with a leg-cutter release. KP spots this early, though, and hits it over the bowler showing the full face of the bat
waits on it this time and pushes it to cover. Length ball again, possibly a slower ball
he's struggling for timing, so far. down the pitch, looks to hit this length ball past cover, possibly, but it doesn't come on and he gets a thick inside edge into the leg side
overpitched, wide outside off, but KP doesn't get hold of it. His drive goes off the toe-end of his bat to mid-off
Johnson strays onto the pads, and Karthik flicks that confidently past square. He's looking in really good touch here.
he's middling everything. This one's a solid punch off the back foot, off a back of a length ball on off stump, and it bounces up and is fielded by point, raising his arms above his head
that's full and wide, and DK drives that, all hands and no feet, to mid-off.
top shot! that was just a touch short, and DK has got on top of it and cut it hard to the right of point.

edged, and gone! No feet again, from Mayank this time, and Johnson gets some bounce from a good length. Agarwal gets a thick edge on his on-the-up drive, and Sehwag catches it above his head at a wide-ish slip.
back of a length, angled towards off stump. It straightens after pitching, and KP gets an inside-edge past his stumps as he slashes at it with no footwork
back of a length, outside off, punched towards point
looks for the single with the nurdle to short fine leg, but Bailey runs to his right from square leg and cuts it off
no turn on this straightish length ball, and KP nudges it into the midwicket area
short, and KP rocks back and cuts hard to the left of point
KP takes two big strides down the pitch and across outside off. Looks to go leg side, but the ball hits him on the pads
skids onto the batsman from just back of a length. Agarwal waits and tucks it away behind square leg

direct hit! the man at point throws hard and flat to the bowler's end after KP sends Agarwal back. The fielder was Maxwell, who picked up this open-faced dab from KP after the ball seamed away from him slightly. The diving Agarwal is home, and Delhi get four overthrows.
length ball, outside off, with a bit of inward angle. KP drives to mid-off
good stop. Akshar dives to his left and saves what might well be four runs, after KP walks across his stumps and flicks it from outside off. A big chip seems to have come off the bottom of his bat.
length ball, outside off, and Agarwal slices it past point with a slightly open face
that's full, on off stump, and a fumble at midwicket allows KP to get off the mark with that flick
that's a length ball wide of off stump, and KP comes forward and drives towards mid-off
That's the winning hit, and it's an emphatic winning hit. It's tossed up on the stumps, and Miller's slog-swept that out of the planet.
short, turns in from outside off, and Miller slaps it straight to cover
Bailey is down the pitch to this, and he flicks it to deep midwicket from outside off

got him! Pitches wide outside off and the googly spins back viciously to knock back off stump as Vohra misses the cut. The rain starts coming down concurrently, quite heavily, and the players go off the field
short, turns in from outside off, punched towards cover
down the pitch, and Nadeem shortens his length. Miller flat-bats that to long-off
makes room this time, and lifts this length ball over cover. Trickles slowly over the boundary cushions
that's wide of leg stump, and Miller sweeps, or helps this along to deep fine leg
tossed up, and Vohra comes forward, knowing he won't get to the pitch of it. He simply goes through with the shot, and chips the ball over extra cover
drops it a touch short, and Vohra makes himself room to punch it to cover
length ball, on the stumps, defended towards mid-on, fielded by the bowler
another googly, and Miller edges it wide of the keeper as he tries to launch it over cover
whoa. What happened there? That was another googly, but he loses his radar completely and slides it full and almost on top of the tram-line outside off stump
googly, and Miller comes down the track and defends into the off side
tossed up, on off stump, and Vohra swats across the line, doesn't git it particularly cleanly, down to deep square leg
that's full, and on the pads, and Vohra flicks against the turn to midwicket
gives himself room to drive through the off side, gets a thick inside edge that runs towards deep midwicket
a bit of turn, from stump-to-stump, and Miller flicks it off his pads to deep square leg
short ball, and Vohra punches it to the right of the off-side sweeper
poor bowling, this. pitches leg, continues with the angle, goes way down the leg side
slow length ball, and Miller reaches out to sweep it to deep square leg
turns into Miller from outside off, and he tucks it off his pads to the left of deep square leg
short ball, and Vohra opens his body completely and swats that, with a bit of a flick of the wrist right at the end, to deep backward square leg
and he's picked that up, easily, effortlessly, from outside off and launched it over long-on
down the pitch, and he doesn't quite get to the pitch. It turns a bit, and he swings it around between long on and deep midwicket. He was looking to hit down the ground, I think
that's tossed up once more, outside off, and Vohra gets a good stride out to square-drive that past point
and he's followed that with a rubbish ball. Skids on with the angle, and goes down the leg side
beauty! that was tossed up, and it dipped on Vohra and turned viciously past his outside edge
straight, on the stumps, and Miller is forward to drive to long-on
Vohra is a lucky boy. Didnt pick the googly, and his attempt at driving inside-out over cover ends up looping over mid-off's head. Safe, though.
googly, I think. It was tossed up on leg stump, and Miller sweeps it hard to deep backward square leg
back of a length, on off stump, skids straight on. Vohra opens his bat-face and dabs it to short third man
goes with the angle, towards the stumps, and Miller comes forward to defend back to the bowler
shortish ball, on the stumps, and it's tucked away towards wide long-on
length ball, swept towards square leg
comes forward and inside the line, opens his bat face to steer it towards point
tossed up, outside off, Miller aims a big drive at it but gets an inside edge into the pitch
that skids on again. From outside leg towards leg stump, and he defends towards cover
that's not too short, and not too wide, but Miller's made himself a lot of room to slash that uppishly but safely past point
this one goes straight on, towards the pads, and it's jammed down towards midwicket
wrong 'un, hurries into Vohra, but he seems to have read it, and he defends it calmly with a twirl of the wrists
straightens from a stump-to-stump line, and it's worked with a turn of the wrists to long-on
full, on the stumps, driven down to long-on
down the leg side, and Miller misses his paddle, and an unsighted DK misses the ball
worked off the pads towards square leg
dropped! that was hit hard, straight back to the bowler, and it hit his fingers and dropped onto the pitch
that's full, on off stump, and Vohra stretches forward, gets his foot next to the line to make room for the swing of the arms and lofts it nicely over extra cover
that's a wide full-toss, and Miller slaps it straight to the sweeper on the off-side boundary
Miller tries to flick this off his pads, gets an inside edge onto them instead

this one isn't short, but it's a half-volley, and Vohra clears his front leg to swing freely through the line and launch that over mid-off. It's hit the rope (or the prism-shaped advertising thingy, whatever it's called) on the full
slides this down the leg side this time, and Vohra gets a bit of thigh pad on this to send it screaming past a diving DK
this short length is getting predictable. This one's in the perfect slot for the slash over point, and he gives himself room and executes it perfectly
gives himself room and tries to slash this short ball but misses
didn't quite get hold of it as he tried to pull this from outside off. It was short and rising, and he gets it high on the bat. Was looking towards deep midwicket, but it goes over mid-on instead
angled towards off stump from back of a length, defended towards point
change of angle doesn't work. Drifts onto Miller's pads, and he tickles it very fine
pushed across Miller from back of a length, defended towards mid-off off the back foot
slower ball, was it? Miller comes down the track, giving himself a bit of room, and cracks it over mid-off, almost flat-bats it
short, rising ball, and DK takes it with his right glove stretched way above his head. It's called wide, and quite right too. It went well over Miller's head as he pulled away from it
that's an awkward-looking shot from Vohra. It was short, but not short enough for the ramp shot, and he ends up hitting it much squarer than he expected, just behind point
pitches on leg and straightens towards leg stump from just back of a length. Miller pushes it to mid-on
that's full and outside off, and Miller comes forward to play the checked drive to mid-off
bit of inward movement from outside off, and Miller is out of his crease to play a defensive push to mid-on
he's back and across this time to defend it solidly
this one comes back in off the seam, from outside off, and Miller moves his body and bat out of the way to let it pass over the stumps
and he's greeted by a monster of a ball. It rises from just short of a good length, and he's hit on the gloves as he pushes at it off the front foot
Maxwell's gone for a duck! it's short and outside off, and Maxwell tries to pull it but ends up slicing a simple catch to KP on the edge of the circle at mid-off
it's full, outside off, and Maxwell punches it powerfully but straight to point
short, and Vohra gets it high on the bat as he tries to pull from outside off and the ball goes high in the air but drops beyond midwicket's reach as he runs towards the boundary
straighter this time, angled towards the top of off, and Maxwell pushes it carefully down to long-on with a bit of wrist
slower ball, outside off, and it sneaks under Maxwell's bat as he tries to slog it away to midwicket
And here's Shami! That's a brutish short ball that rises up and hits the batsman on the shoulder as he tries to sway his head out of the way
got him! Sehwag tries that backfoot punch again, but his feet were cemented to the ground and he gets a thin outside edge as the ball seams away a touch, with a bit of extra bounce
slight bit of width outside off and Sehwag gets a lot of power into this backfoot punch. Point jumps in the air to field it on the bounce
poor ball, just doesn't come out right, and it slides well down the leg side
better this time. Gets a decent stride in to meet it with his head over the ball and defend towards point
angled across Vohra again, on a good length, and that front foot doesn't quite come out of the crease as he pushes at it and is beaten
slower ball, outside off, and a slightly overbalanced Vohra is on the walk as he pushes it towards point
shortish, widish, and Vohra punches that to point, who has to dive to his right to stop it
bouncer, and he sways out of the way
tries to loft on the up over long-off, mistimes it over extra cover, falls well short of the rope
lovely! that's back of a length, outside off, and Sehwag is on the jump again to help it with a straight bat between point and cover
drifts towards the leg side this time, and Sehwag is on his toes to flick it off his hips past square leg
bouncer this time, and Sehwag ducks his head to let it go over him
shorter now, and Sehwag jumps up to defend back to the bowler
away movement again, and Vohra gets a thickish edge down to third man
angles this in, and gets a bit of lift as well as away movement. Sehwag gets a thick edge down to third man
